channel.description: Stay updated on the latest news and events happening in the RPI community.

item.title: Spring 2027 Study Abroad Application Now Open!
item.description: The application for spring 2027 study abroad is now open. Undergraduates can log into the study abroad application portal with their RCS ID and password. Visit the Education Abroad website for details: https://isss.rpi.edu/education-abroad. Questions? Contact Karen Dvorak, Education Abroad Program Manager, dvorak2@rpi.edu.
item.author: Students

item.title: Webinar: Why Master’s Students Should Plan on a 9 Month Job Search
item.description: Date: Wednesday, August 19, 2026 2:00 PM - 3:30 PM - As a master’s student, you’ll be managing course work, internships, and professional development. On top of this, you’ll need to plan and prepare for your job search. This is a lot to manage but starting early is one of the most important things you can do. Join Beyond Graduate School for this webinar designed specifically for new master’s students. This webinar will help you build the skills and knowledge you need to begin an effective job…

item.title: Sign Up for Orchestra, Choir, and Wind Symphony Auditions
item.description: OPEN TO ALL STUDENTS, FACULTY, AND STAFF! Do you play an instrument or sing? Are you interested in joining one of RPI’s musical ensembles? Join us for Ensemble Auditions Mon. August 24th - Sat. August 29th. Please sign up for an audition time on our website. Please reach out to Dr. Robert Whalen, whaler2@rpi.edu, with any questions about the audition process. We look forward to welcoming you!

item.title: Updates around campus
item.description: You may start to notice some new signs and updates to signage around campus! We’re making a few changes to help create a more welcoming, clear, and easy-to-navigate environment for everyone in our community. As the updates roll out, you may see new signs popping up or some familiar ones being replaced. We’re excited for you to see the changes and appreciate your patience as we work to give our campus a fresh new look! Union Lots: 30-minute parking is available for short-term visits. Sherry Road…

item.title: Single Course Enrollment Options
item.description: Date: Wednesday, August 19, 2026 12:00 PM - 12:30 PM - Aric Krause, Ph.D., will host this RPI at Work information session reviewing the online graduate programs for working professionals and provide course enrollment options to make an immediate impact on one’s work. Participants can also explore courses for developing valuable skills that benefit employee and employer alike. Please register to attend

item.title: Rensselaer Faculty and Staff Quick Learn Webinar - Ways to Engage Students with Reading Assignments and Micro Video Lectures
item.description: Date: Wednesday, August 26, 2026 12:30 PM - 1:00 PM - Assigning reading assignments and micro video lectures prior to class is always a great option to allow students to gather initial knowledge. This session will review some tips on how we can engage and motivate the students through these readings or video lectures to guide them in pulling out the important details/understandings. To register for this workshop and see a list of other upcoming workshops, please use the link in the See section.

item.title: Updates to the student experience
item.description: As we prepare for the year ahead, you are invited to join us for a campus-wide conversation about updates designed to support and strengthen the student experience on August 19 from 9–11 a.m. at CBIS, Auditorium.

item.title: The Countdown Is On! RPI’s Annual Staff Awards Are Almost Here
item.description:
The countdown is on! Soon, you’ll have the opportunity to celebrate the people and teams who help RPI thrive through RPI’s Annual Staff Awards Program. Starting August 17, you’ll have the opportunity to nominate a colleague or team whose contributions, creativity, dedication, and impact truly stand out.

For information about sharing your news or events, or to change your subscription settings, visit morningmail.rpi.edu.
